description: Transitive closure: four-hop kill chain with a CVE at each step. Tests become closure depth and derivation tree.

cve_queries.chain: attacker → bastion:sshd (CVE-2023-38408, OpenSSH 9.1p1) → become _host_bastion → can_reach webservers:httpd (bastion→web rule) → CVE-2021-41773 (Apache 2.4.49) → become _host_webservers → can_reach appservers:8080 (web→app rule) → CVE-2021-44228 (Log4j 2.14.1) → become _host_appservers → can_reach dbservers:postgresql (app→db rule) → CVE-2013-1903 (PostgreSQL 9.2.3) → become _host_dbservers → db:login:superuser
